description.value: Virtue Natural Bakery is an artisanal gluten-free bakery-café on West Broadway in Kitsilano, founded in 2017 by Certified Natural Chef Lisa Virtue. Every item — from sourdough-style loaves and French baguettes to brownies, butter tarts, and specialty cookies — is made with organic and seasonal ingredients and is 100% gluten-free, with many options also dairy-free, egg-free, or grain-free. Specialty organic coffee roasted by Moja Coffee and loose-leaf teas from Denman Island Tea Company make it a worthwhile stop for cyclists looking for quality café fare and fresh-baked provisions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and richly detailed. The contact page confirms address (2245 West Broadway, Vancouver BC), phone (604-505-1305), and operating status; the careers page lists active hiring for May-June 2026, confirming the business is currently open. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or water bottle refills appears anywhere on the site, so all cycling-infrastructure amenities default to null. The OSM record had no address or phone, so only the website URL could be cross-checked for contact_confirmed.
concerns: OSM record is missing address and phone; both were sourced from the website only.
OSM shop=bakery is loosely mapped to the Groceries category; this is a specialty gluten-free bakery-café, not a general grocery store.
Business is explicitly a computer-free café (no laptops or tablets); notable policy for cyclists who may want to work while stopped.
Business no longer accepts cash; card payment only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating bakery-café on a major cycling corridor in Kitsilano; useful to touring cyclists for fresh baked goods, bread, and specialty coffee.
